name: Martinus Legionensis
claimNotes: Entire corpus untranslated. Liber Sermonum (c.1200) and biblical commentaries remain in Latin only.

name: Remigius Antissiodorensis
claimNotes: Extensive glosses and commentaries on classical texts (Vergil, Terence, Cato), biblical commentaries (Genesis, Psalms), and works on Boethius, Martianus Capella, and grammarians—all untranslated.

name: Zacharias Chrysopolitanus
claimNotes: Entire corpus of biblical commentaries (1 work, 241,691 words) lacks English translation. His commentary drawing on Ambrose, Augustine, and Jerome has no modern English rendering.

name: Ekkehardus Uraugiensis
claimNotes: Chronicon universale (world chronicle with German history 1098–1125).

name: Robertus Pullus
claimNotes: Sententiarum Theologicarum Libri Octo (theological compendium, served as official university textbook); all major works remain untranslated.

name: Garnerius Lingonensis
claimNotes: Sermones in festa Domini et Sanctorum, Vita Operaque, Allegoriae sacrae scripturae

name: Taio Caesaraugustanus

name: Hariulfus Aldenburgensis

name: Joannes diaconus (Hymonides)
